description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Ice, Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth] after using a Ice/Lightning/Earth ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Xezat
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Martial Legacy (0~2), removed after using Martial Legacy two times

description.name: Martial Legacy Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Martial Legacy level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Xezat]

description.name: Martial Legacy Level
description.text: Keeps track of Martial Legacy level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Xezat]
